goals.text: online ordering website for its single shop in Lahore
goals.quote: Sweet Crumbs Bakery wants an online ordering website for its single shop in Lahore.

users.quote: The website is for customers who want to order cakes and pastries for pickup.
The bakery staff need an admin page to view all orders for a selected date.

features.text: browse a menu of products with name, photo, price and description
features.quote: Customers must be able to browse a menu of products with a name, photo, price and description for each item.

features.text: add products to a cart and change the quantity of each item
features.quote: Customers must be able to add products to a cart and change the quantity of each item.

features.text: choose a pickup date and a pickup time slot when placing an order
features.quote: Customers must choose a pickup date and a pickup time slot when placing an order.

features.text: receive a confirmation email with an order number
features.quote: After placing an order, the customer must receive a confirmation email with an order number.

features.text: admin page to view all orders for a selected date
features.quote: The bakery staff need an admin page to view all orders for a selected date.
Staff must be able to mark an order as "Ready" or "Collected".

features.text: add, edit and remove menu products from the admin page
features.quote: Staff must be able to add, edit and remove menu products from the admin page.

constraints.text: Pickup time slots are every 30 minutes between 10:00 AM and 8:00 PM.
constraints.quote: Pickup time slots are every 30 minutes between 10:00 AM and 8:00 PM.

constraints.text: Payment is cash on pickup only; no online payment is needed.
constraints.quote: Payment is cash on pickup only; no online payment is needed.

constraints.text: The website must be available in English only.
constraints.quote: The website must be available in English only.

deadlines.quote: The website must go live by 15 December 2026.

priorities.text: menu and ordering pages are the highest priority
priorities.quote: The menu and ordering pages are the highest priority.

terms_used.quote: Sweet Crumbs Bakery wants an online ordering website for its single shop in Lahore.
